issues.detail: The Greek 'ολου του εθνους των ιουδαιων' means 'all the nation of the Jews'. The Vietnamese translation 'cả dân ngoại Giu-đa' (all the Gentiles of Judah) changes the meaning from the Jewish people to the Gentiles.

The Greek 'μαρτυρουμενος τε' implies a continuous action ('who was being testified to') which is slightly diminished in the Vietnamese structure, but the primary issue is the identity of the people testifying.
